description: The signed-in couple's own wedding registry on Zola, checked for problems: the items that the couple marked as received with no purchase (guests cannot buy them), the items bought with no Zola order (a guest bought it in another store, so the giver is unknown), and the counts of the items that guests can still buy. For a list of the items, use zola_search_my_registry_items. For the gifts, use zola_get_my_gift_tracker. Requires Zola sign-in (account:read).
name: zola_check_my_registry

outputSchema.description: The checks of the wedding registry of the signed-in couple

exists.description: False when the account has no wedding registry

hidden_surprise_gifts.description: The surprise gifts that are not revealed yet. Their items are not in the guest orders

purchased.description: The units that Zola counts as bought
